name: comp-323
title: Rating Dialog
blurb: Gathers ratings on a 0-8 scale with an optional explanation.
description: A shadcn Dialog with a 9-option radio button scale (0-8) and textarea for explaining the rating, separated by a header border.
use_when: Collecting structured feedback on onboarding difficulty, feature usability, or user satisfaction with explanations.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces where small radio buttons are difficult to select; consider a simpler star or thumbs-up scale…
a11y: Radio buttons use shadcn RadioGroup; fieldset has a legend describing the question; textarea has aria-label; full keyboard navigation.
